title: SSC CPO Paper-1 Full Length Mock Test 15 (Hard Level)
description: Hard Level Full Length Mock Test for SSC CPO SI Paper-1. 100 Questions | 60 Minutes | Reasoning 25, GA 25, Quant 25, English 25.
instructions: Yeh Hard Level Full Length Mock Test hai.
Total 100 questions: General Intelligence & Reasoning 25, General Knowledge & GA 25, Quantitative Aptitude 25, English Comprehension 25.
Har question 1 mark ka hai. Galat jawab par 0.25 marks katenge.
SSC CPO SI Paper-1 latest pattern ke anusar (condensed 100Q mock).

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Doctor : Hospital :: Teacher : ?
questions.explanation: A doctor works in a hospital. Similarly, a teacher works in a school.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Ocean : Water :: Glacier : ?
questions.explanation: Ocean is made of water. Glacier is made of ice.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Find the missing number: 3, 8, 15, 24, 35, ?

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: What comes next in the series: 1, 4, 9, 16, 25, ?
questions.explanation: Squares of natural numbers: 1², 2², 3², 4², 5², 6²=36.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: If 'COMPUTER' is coded as 'DPNQVUFS', how is 'LAPTOP' coded?
questions.explanation: Each letter is increased by 1: C→D, O→P, M→N, etc. So L→M, A→B, P→Q, T→U, O→P, P→Q → MBQUPQ.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: In a certain code, 'FRUIT' is written as 'HTWKV'. How is 'APPLE' written in that code?
questions.explanation: Each letter +2: F→H, R→T, U→W, I→K, T→V. So A→C, P→R, P→R, L→N, E→G → CRRNG.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Pointing to a lady, a man said, 'She is the daughter of my mother's only son.' How is the lady related to the man?
questions.explanation: My mother's only son is myself. So she is my daughter.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: A is B's sister. C is B's mother. D is C's father. E is D's mother. How is A related to D?
questions.explanation: D is father of C (mother of B and A). So A is granddaughter of D.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: A person starts from point A, walks 10 km East, then turns right and walks 5 km, then turns right and walks 10 km. In which direction is he from the starting point?
questions.explanation: East 10, South 5, West 10. Net: 5 km South from start.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Rahul walks 20 m North, then turns left and walks 15 m, then turns left and walks 20 m. How far and in which direction is he from starting point?
questions.explanation: North 20, West 15, South 20. Net displacement 15 m West.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Statements: All cats are dogs. Some dogs are rats. Conclusions: I. Some cats are rats. II. Some rats are dogs.
questions.explanation: II definitely follows. I does not necessarily follow.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Statements: No bird is an animal. All animals are humans. Conclusions: I. No bird is human. II. Some humans are not birds.
questions.explanation: From the statements, some humans (animals) are not birds. I does not follow.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Find the odd one out: 11, 13, 17, 19, 21
questions.explanation: 11,13,17,19 are prime numbers. 21 is composite (3×7).

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Select the odd one: Square, Circle, Triangle, Rectangle
questions.explanation: Circle has no straight sides; others are polygons with straight sides.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: In a row of 40 students, Ravi is 15th from left. What is his position from right?
questions.explanation: Position from right = Total - Position from left + 1 = 40 - 15 + 1 = 26.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: A is taller than B but shorter than C. D is taller than C. Who is the tallest?
questions.explanation: Order: D > C > A > B. D is tallest.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Five friends A, B, C, D, E are sitting in a row. A is between B and C. D is to the right of C. E is at one end. Who is at the other end?
questions.explanation: Possible arrangement: B A C D E or E D C A B. In both cases B is at one end.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Which of the following diagrams correctly represents the relationship between Doctors, Males and Females?
options: Two intersecting circles inside a big circle
Two separate circles inside a big one
questions.explanation: Some doctors are male, some female; males and females are mutually exclusive.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: In a certain matrix, rows follow a pattern. If first row is 2 4 8, second is 3 6 12, what is third row starting with 4?
questions.explanation: Each number is doubled: 2×2=4, 4×2=8; similarly for others.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: If 1st January 2024 is Monday, what day will be 1st January 2025?
questions.explanation: 2024 is a leap year, so 366 days = 52 weeks + 2 days. Monday + 2 = Wednesday.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: At what time between 3 and 4 o'clock will the hands of the clock be together?

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Find the wrong number: 5, 10, 20, 40, 80, 150
questions.explanation: Each is double of previous: 5×2=10,10×2=20,...80×2=160, not 150.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Complete the series: ACE, BDF, CEG, ?
questions.explanation: A+1=B, C+1=D, E+1=F; next D+1=E, F+1=G, H+1=I → DFH.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Pen : Write :: Knife : ?
questions.explanation: Pen is used to write. Knife is used to cut.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Statement: All students passed the exam. Conclusion: Some students failed the exam.
questions.explanation: If all passed, none failed. Conclusion does not follow.

questions.subject: GA
questions.question: Who was the first President of India?
questions.explanation: Dr. Rajendra Prasad was the first President of India (1950-1962).

questions.subject: GA
questions.question: The Battle of Plassey was fought in which year?
questions.explanation: Battle of Plassey was fought in 1757 between British and Siraj-ud-Daulah.

questions.subject: GA
questions.question: Which is the longest river in India?
questions.explanation: Ganga is the longest river in India (approx 2525 km).

questions.subject: GA
questions.question: The Tropic of Cancer passes through how many states of India?
questions.explanation: Tropic of Cancer passes through 8 Indian states.

questions.subject: GA
questions.question: How many fundamental rights are there in the Indian Constitution?
questions.explanation: There are 6 Fundamental Rights in the Indian Constitution.

questions.subject: GA
questions.question: Who is the current Chairman of Rajya Sabha?
questions.explanation: The Vice President of India is the ex-officio Chairman of Rajya Sabha.

questions.subject: GA
questions.question: What is the chemical formula of Water?
questions.explanation: Water is H2O.

questions.subject: GA
questions.question: Which planet is known as the Red Planet?
questions.explanation: Mars is called the Red Planet due to iron oxide on its surface.

questions.subject: GA
questions.question: Who is known as the father of Indian Economy?
questions.explanation: Dadabhai Naoroji is known as the father of Indian Economics (Drain Theory).

questions.subject: GA
questions.question: What is the capital of Australia?
questions.explanation: Canberra is the capital of Australia.

questions.subject: GA
questions.question: Which is the largest desert in the world?
questions.explanation: Antarctic Desert is the largest desert in the world by area.

questions.subject: GA
questions.question: Which country hosted the G20 Summit in 2023?
questions.explanation: India hosted the G20 Summit in 2023 (New Delhi).

questions.subject: GA
questions.question: The Quit India Movement was launched in which year?
questions.explanation: Quit India Movement was launched by Mahatma Gandhi in 1942.

questions.subject: GA
questions.question: Which is the highest mountain peak in India?
questions.explanation: Kangchenjunga is the highest peak in India (Everest is in Nepal).

questions.subject: GA
questions.question: Article 21 of the Indian Constitution deals with?
options: Right to Life and Personal Liberty
questions.explanation: Article 21 guarantees the Right to Life and Personal Liberty.

questions.subject: GA
questions.question: What is the unit of electric current?
questions.explanation: Ampere (A) is the SI unit of electric current.

questions.subject: GA
questions.question: Who wrote the book 'Discovery of India'?
questions.explanation: Jawaharlal Nehru wrote 'The Discovery of India'.

questions.subject: GA
questions.question: Who is the first Indian to win an individual Olympic gold medal?
questions.explanation: Abhinav Bindra won the first individual Olympic gold for India in 2008 (10m Air Rifle).

questions.subject: GA
questions.question: Which gas is most responsible for global warming?
questions.explanation: Carbon dioxide (CO2) is the primary greenhouse gas responsible for global warming.

questions.subject: GA
questions.question: Who founded the Maurya Empire?
questions.explanation: Chandragupta Maurya founded the Maurya Empire with the help of Chanakya.

questions.subject: GA
questions.question: The Sundarbans is located in which state?
questions.explanation: Sundarbans (largest mangrove forest) is mainly in West Bengal.

questions.subject: GA
questions.question: The minimum age to become President of India is?
questions.explanation: Minimum age for President of India is 35 years.

questions.subject: GA
questions.question: Which vitamin is produced when skin is exposed to sunlight?
questions.explanation: Vitamin D is synthesized in the skin upon exposure to sunlight.

questions.subject: GA
questions.question: What is the national animal of India?
questions.explanation: The Bengal Tiger is the national animal of India.

questions.subject: GA
questions.question: Which is the highest civilian award in India?
questions.explanation: Bharat Ratna is the highest civilian award in India.

questions.subject: Quant
questions.question: What is 25% of 480?

questions.subject: Quant
questions.question: A shopkeeper buys an article for ₹800 and sells it for ₹1000. What is the profit percentage?

questions.subject: Quant
questions.question: Find the simple interest on ₹5000 at 8% per annum for 3 years.

questions.subject: Quant
questions.question: What will be the compound interest on ₹10000 at 10% per annum for 2 years?

questions.subject: Quant
questions.question: Divide ₹1200 in the ratio 2:3. What is the larger share?
questions.explanation: Total parts = 5. Larger = (3/5)×1200 = 720.

questions.subject: Quant
questions.question: The average of 5 numbers is 20. If one number is excluded, the average becomes 18. What is the excluded number?
questions.explanation: Total of 5 = 100. Total of 4 = 72. Excluded = 100-72=28.

questions.subject: Quant
questions.question: A can do a work in 10 days and B in 15 days. In how many days will they complete the work together?
questions.explanation: 1/10 + 1/15 = 5/30 = 1/6. Together in 6 days.

questions.subject: Quant
questions.question: A train travels 240 km in 4 hours. What is its speed?
questions.explanation: Speed = Distance/Time = 240/4 = 60 km/h.

questions.subject: Quant
questions.question: What is the LCM of 12 and 18?
questions.explanation: LCM of 12 and 18 is 36.

questions.subject: Quant
questions.question: What is the HCF of 24 and 36?
questions.explanation: HCF of 24 and 36 is 12.

questions.subject: Quant
questions.question: If x + 1/x = 5, then x² + 1/x² = ?

questions.subject: Quant
questions.question: The sum of interior angles of a pentagon is?
questions.explanation: Sum = (n-2)×180 = 3×180 = 540° for pentagon.

questions.subject: Quant
questions.question: Find the area of a rectangle with length 12 cm and breadth 8 cm.
questions.explanation: Area = l × b = 12 × 8 = 96 cm².

questions.subject: Quant
questions.question: The circumference of a circle is 44 cm. Find its radius (π=22/7).

questions.subject: Quant
questions.question: If the price of a commodity increases by 20% and then decreases by 20%, the net change is?
questions.explanation: Net effect = -4% (successive percentage change).

questions.subject: Quant
questions.question: A man sells two articles for ₹500 each. On one he gains 20% and on the other he loses 20%. Overall profit/loss is?
questions.explanation: Always loss of (x²/100)% = 4% loss when equal SP and equal % gain/loss.

questions.subject: Quant
questions.question: A car covers 150 km in 2.5 hours. What is its average speed?

questions.subject: Quant
questions.question: Solve for x: 2x + 5 = 15

questions.subject: Quant
questions.question: If a pie chart shows 40% for one sector, what is the central angle for that sector?

questions.subject: Quant
questions.question: In what ratio should water be mixed with milk costing ₹20/litre so that the mixture costs ₹15/litre?

questions.subject: Quant
questions.question: A and B invest ₹5000 and ₹8000 respectively. After 1 year, profit is ₹1300. What is A's share?
questions.explanation: Ratio 5:8. Total 13 parts. A gets (5/13)×1300 = 500.

questions.subject: Quant
questions.question: The present age of father is 3 times that of son. After 10 years, father will be twice as old as son. Present age of son is?
questions.explanation: Let son = x, father = 3x. After 10: 3x+10 = 2(x+10) → 3x+10=2x+20 → x=10.

questions.subject: Quant
questions.question: A pipe can fill a tank in 6 hours. Another pipe can empty it in 8 hours. If both are opened together, in how many hours will the tank be filled?

questions.subject: Quant
questions.question: Value of sin 30° is?

questions.subject: Quant
questions.question: The mean of 5, 7, 9, 11, 13 is?

questions.subject: English
questions.question: Choose the synonym of 'Abundant':
questions.explanation: Abundant means plentiful or existing in large quantities.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: Choose the antonym of 'Ancient':
questions.explanation: Ancient means very old; antonym is modern.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: What does the idiom 'Break the ice' mean?
questions.explanation: 'Break the ice' means to initiate a conversation or make a situation less formal.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: He is good _____ mathematics.
questions.explanation: The correct preposition is 'good at' something.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: Identify the error: 'She don't like coffee.'
questions.explanation: Should be 'She doesn't like coffee.' (subject-verb agreement).

questions.subject: English
questions.question: A person who loves books is called:
questions.explanation: Bibliophile is a lover of books.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: Which is the correct spelling?
questions.explanation: Correct spelling is Accommodate (double c, double m).

questions.subject: English
questions.question: Improve: 'I am looking forward to meet you.'
questions.explanation: After 'looking forward to', use gerund: to meeting you.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: Change to passive: 'The teacher taught the students.'
options: The students were taught by the teacher.
The students are taught by the teacher.
The students have been taught by the teacher.
The teacher was taught the students.
questions.explanation: Simple past active becomes simple past passive: were taught.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: Change to indirect: He said, 'I am tired.'
options: He said that he was tired.
He said that he is tired.
He said that I am tired.
questions.explanation: Present becomes past in reported speech: was tired.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: Synonym of 'Brave':
questions.explanation: Brave means courageous.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: Antonym of 'Generous':
questions.explanation: Generous means giving; antonym is stingy.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: Meaning of 'Once in a blue moon':
questions.explanation: 'Once in a blue moon' means very rarely.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: Neither of the boys _____ present.
questions.explanation: 'Neither' takes singular verb: was.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: Find the error: 'Each of the students have a book.'
questions.explanation: Should be 'has' because 'each' is singular.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: A place where birds are kept:
questions.explanation: Aviary is a large cage or building for keeping birds.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: What is the meaning of 'Ephemeral'?
options: Lasting for a very short time
questions.explanation: Ephemeral means lasting for a very short time.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: Correct the sentence: 'He has been working here since five years.'
questions.explanation: Use 'for' with duration: for five years. 'Since' is for point of time.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: Read: 'The sun rises in the east.' This is an example of:
questions.explanation: It is a universally accepted fact.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: She is interested _____ learning French.
questions.explanation: Correct collocation: interested in.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: I will go _____ you come with me.
questions.explanation: Conditional: if you come with me.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: By next year, I _____ my degree.
questions.explanation: Future perfect tense for action completed before a future point.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: _____ honest man is always respected.
questions.explanation: Honest starts with vowel sound, so 'An'.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: Meaning of 'Give up':
questions.explanation: 'Give up' means to surrender or stop trying.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: The _____ of the mountain was breathtaking.
questions.explanation: View, sight, and scene can all fit in this context appropriately.
